about.data:
Introducing Binghatti Dawn, an upcoming project by Binghatti Developers located in the vibrant Jumeirah Village Circle (JVC), Dubai. Binghatti Dawn consists of four floors above the ground with two basement levels for parking. The low-rise development offers premium studios and 1 and 2 bedroom apartments.

Residents can enjoy premium amenities, like a swimming pool, kids' play areas, and a state-of-the-art fitness center. Binghatti Dawn Residences offers a refined living experience in one of Dubai's most coveted areas. Its prime location ensures Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road and Al Khail Road connectivity, providing residents with easy access to Downtown Dubai and Dubai Marina.

One Park Central is an exceptional mixed-use tower located in Jumeirah Village Circle. Boasting premium amenities, including dedicated fitness and wellness facilities, it offers a realm of luxury through meticulously crafted retail, commercial, and residential units. 

The project by Iman Developers, One Park Central, features studio to 2-bedroom apartments, 2-bedroom duplex units, and 3- and 4-bedroom penthouses. One Park Central at JVC enjoys a central location with easy access to key areas like Palm Jumeirah and Dubai Marina.

Binghatti Grove at JVC offers luxury apartments in Jumeirah Village Circle, developed by Binghatti Developers. This off-plan property features 1, 2, and 3-bedroom apartments designed with biophilic architecture, blending nature and contemporary living. The 42-story tower showcases elegant facades and sustainable materials. On the ground floor of Binghatti Grove, there are 16 retail spaces.

Residents can enjoy many amenities, including a serene pool deck, outdoor yoga areas, fitness zones, and sports courts. Binghatti Grove's location provides easy access to crucial routes like Al Khail Road, making it a prime spot for city living. Binghatti Grove in JVC combines luxury with sustainability, offering a unique living experience in Dubai’s thriving community.

more_info.question: Property Insights and JVC Floor Plans

data.answer:
Opting for Jumeirah Village Circle rental properties offers a practical choice for individuals seeking affordable accommodation in a prime location with modern lifestyle amenities and proximity to key areas of Dubai. Likewise, prospective investors eyeing property purchases in JVC can anticipate attractive returns on their investment.

Upcoming Projects in JVC

Here is a list of off-plan projects in the JVC district.

Concept 7 Residences

The Concept 7 Residences by Condor is one of the upcoming Jumeirah Village Circle projects comprising studio, 1 and 2-bedroom apartments. Close to Jumeirah Village Circle Mall, the project will feature amenities like jogging tracks, cycling tracks, a kids' play area, and much more.

Binghatti Tulip

It is a multi-story apartment offering studio to 3-bedroom units. Green parking facilities and private pool residences are some of the highlights of Binghatti Tulip.

Binghatti Amber

A blend of contemporary designs infused with traditional Middle Eastern nuances, Binghatti Amber at JVC enjoys a prime location within the community. The prices of apartments in this exquisite project start at AED 557k.

Binghatti Gardenia

The opulent tower Binghatti Gardenia is aesthetically designed and will offer amenities like an on-site wellness center, a stunning adult pool, and a kids' pool area.

Binghatti House

Binghatti House in JVC introduces a recent high-rise project comprising 27 residential floors, providing a selection of studios and 1- and 2-bedroom apartments.

Renting a Property in Jumeirah Village Circle

Jumeirah Village Circle in Dubai is a top-notch choice for individuals seeking cost-effective apartment and villa options. District 13 and District 14, among its various sub-communities, house numerous sought-after properties for those interested in JVC apartments for rent.

Studio Apartments JVC are available for an annual lease starting at AED 36k. Notably, Ghalia Constella and Kensington Mano are the area's most popular buildings, offering studios. Le Grand Chateau Jumeirah Village Circle in District 10 is also popular for renting studio units.

1-bedroom rental flats in JVC typically cost around AED 51k, while individuals seeking more spacious accommodations can explore 2 bedroom apartment for rent in JVC for an average of AED 72k. There is also a diverse selection of 3-bedroom Jumeirah Village Circle apartments for rent, ranging between AED 100k and AED 260k per annum.

The more opulent 3-bedroom units, spanning over 2,000 sq. ft., are predominantly located in Astoria Residence. 2 bedroom apartments for rent in Dubai JVC are available at City. You can also find hotel apartments in JVC for short-term rentals.

Individuals desiring top-floor residences with panoramic views can explore JVC's exclusive collection of 2 to 4-bed penthouses for rent, starting from AED 140k. Villas and townhouses in the Jumeirah Village Circle area are also available for an affordable starting rent of AED 95k, making them an ideal choice for families.

Buying a Property in Jumeirah Village Circle

Studios JVC apartments for sale are available for an average of AED 454k, while 1-bedroom flats are priced at around AED 729k. For those eyeing 2-bedroom Jumeirah Village Circle apartments, the starting price is approximately AED 1M. 3-bedroom JVC Dubai apartments are available for purchase at an estimated cost of AED 1.4M.

Prospective buyers interested in JVC penthouses can expect prices ranging from AED 1.1M to AED 7.1M. City Apartments JVC, La Riviera Apartments JVC and Park Corner Jumeirah Village Circle are popular choices for buyers and investors interested in the community.

Townhouses and villas in JVC offer affordability within the mid-high income range. Average prices begin at AED 1.2M and extend up to AED 3.2M. A standard 2-bedroom villa, spanning over 2,000 sq. ft., is priced at around AED 1.9M.

Meanwhile, a 3-bedroom villa is available for purchase at approximately AED 2M. The starting price for 4-bedroom villas is AED 1.5M, and 5-bedroom villas range from AED 2.3M to AED 5.5M. Nakheel Villas Jumeirah Village Circle and Park Villas Jumeirah Village Circle are the popular communities for buying villas in JVC.

Additional options encompass a 1-bedroom townhouse for sale, with relatively affordable starting prices of AED 1.4M. For those seeking 3-bedroom townhouses in JVC, the cost is around AED 1.8M. 4-bedroom townhomes are available in JVC, with prices ranging from AED 1.64M to AED 4.6M.

more_info.question: What’s Life Like in Jumeirah Village Circle?

data.answer:
JVC Dubai is known for its community-centric atmosphere, making it ideal for families and individuals seeking a friendly and welcoming environment. The circular layout of the community promotes a sense of unity.

Jumeirah Village Circle is equipped with essential amenities such as schools, healthcare facilities, supermarkets, and retail outlets. The community is continuously evolving, with more amenities being added to enhance the overall lifestyle.

Public Transportation in Jumeirah Village Circle

Buses and taxis are the most commonly used modes of public transportation in Jumeirah Village Circle. Bus J01 serves the area, with multiple stations connecting residents to destinations such as the Mall of the Emirates and neighboring areas.

What is the nearest metro station to Jumeirah Village Circle? The Mall of the Emirates Metro Station is the nearest option for those using the Dubai Metro for commutes. The area is also easily accessible through Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road, Al Khail Road, and Hessa Street.

Supermarkets in Jumeirah Village Circle

Jumeirah Village Circle (JVC) in Dubai has various supermarkets to cater to residents' daily needs. Spinneys’ JVC location is ideal for residents and it offers a variety of groceries, fresh produce, and household items.

Carrefour Market is also available in JVC, providing a range of products, including groceries, fresh produce, and household essentials. Choithrams, a popular choice for residents, and Blue Mart are easily accessible from the community.

Shopping Malls in and near JVC Dubai

Living in JVC offers the advantage of being close to an array of shopping options. In addition to numerous shopping malls along Al Khail Road, residents can now benefit from the extensive Circle Mall JVC Dubai. This expansive retail and entertainment destination by Nakheel, Jumeirah Village Circle Mall, is conveniently located near the Fortunato community, Manhattan Towers, and Crystal Residence.

Another popular choice nearby is the Mall of the Emirates, easily accessible through the J01 bus route from Jumeirah Village Circle. Beyond its shopping and dining options, the mall provides an array of enjoyable activities for adults and children.

Schools and Nurseries in Jumeirah Village Circle

Jumeirah Village Circle boasts three nurseries, including Kids World Nursery, Little Wonders Nursery, and Ladybird Early Learning Centre. There are also various schools in Jumeirah Village Circle. JSS International School is one of the highly sought-after educational institutions in JVC, providing the ICSE curriculum up to Year 12. Schools near JVC include Sunmarke School and the Nord Anglia International School, which offer a comprehensive 13-year syllabus.

Churches, Temples, and Mosques in and near JVC Location

Jumeirah Village Circle has two mosques: JVC Mosque and Saleh Bin Lahej Mosque. Another notable mosque in the area is Masjid Fatma Al Sayed Mohammad Yousuf Sharaf.

The Emirates Baptist Church in Al Barsha is the closest church, accessible within a 15-minute drive. The Krishna and Shiva Temple is approximately a 30-minute drive away for those looking for Hindu temples.

Clinics and Hospitals in and near Jumeirah Village Circle Area

Karama Medical Centre is a primary choice for healthcare for JVC residents. Emirates Hospital Day Surgery in Motor City and Mediclinic Park View Hospital on Umm Suqeim Road can be reached within a 15-minute drive for comprehensive multi-specialty hospital services.

JVC Dubai Location & Nearby Areas

Strategically positioned in the heart of Dubai, Jumeirah Village Circle (JVC) provides residents with a central location and effortless access to key areas throughout the city. Easily accessible via Al Khail Road and Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road, JVC ensures smooth connectivity to vital business hubs such as Dubai Media City, Dubai Internet City, and Dubai Marina.

The community is conveniently near popular neighborhoods like Jumeirah Lake Towers (JLT), Dubai Sports City, and Arabian Ranches.

more_info.question: Things to Do in the Jumeirah Village Circle Area

data.answer:
Jumeirah Village Circle Dubai offers diverse activities and attractions catering to residents and visitors alike. From dining out to watching a movie, there are plenty of things to do in the Jumeirah Village Circle area:

Fitness, Wellness and Outdoor Activities

The beautifully landscaped parks interconnecting the villages are perfect for those who appreciate leisurely walks along the tracks beneath the well-kept tree canopy. Prime Fitness Gym, Well Fit, and Gym Nation are some popular gyms in JVC. The Jumeirah Village Circle community also houses various spas and salons, including Nail Atelier Salon Jumeirah Village Circle, N Bar Nails Spa and Salon, Nature True Spa, and more.

Jumeirah Village Circle Restaurants

Jumeirah Village Circle (JVC) offers a diverse culinary scene with an array of restaurants in JVC catering to various tastes. Some noteworthy dining establishments are JVC Epona Lounge, Park and Shop Restaurant, and The Cavendish Restaurant. Epona Lounge is a stylish lounge offering a mix of international and Middle Eastern cuisine, while Park and Shop Restaurant is a family-friendly spot with a casual atmosphere.

The Cavendish Restaurant is known for its British-inspired menu, cozy setting, and selection of comfort food favorites. Taqado Mexican Kitchen in JVC serves up fresh and flavorful Mexican dishes, including tacos, burritos, and bowls. Moreover, Little Bangkok brings Thai flavors to JVC, offering a menu with various authentic Thai dishes in a vibrant setting.

If you're in the mood for pizza and Italian cuisine, Pizza Di Rocco is a popular choice in JVC, known for its delicious wood-fired pizzas. Circle Cafe is a casual dining spot with a diverse menu that includes salads, sandwiches, and hearty mains, along with a selection of beverages.

Beaches Near Jumeirah Village Circle

One of the delightful pastimes cherished by many in Dubai is a day at the beach. For Jumeirah Village Circle (JVC) residents, the nearest coastal retreats, including JBR, Kite Beach, and the open beach in Jumeirah, are all conveniently reachable in under half an hour. A beach day is just one of the numerous enjoyable activities in JVC.

Hotels in and near Jumeirah Village Circle

In addition to residential JVC properties, hotels in Jumeirah Village Circle (JVC) also contribute to the diverse accommodation offerings in the neighborhood.

FIVE Jumeirah Village Circle is a luxurious 5-star hotel in a striking 60-story tower. The hotel boasts dedicated street food and fine dining options, along with amenities such as a spa, a fully equipped gym, an outdoor pool area, and ample parking space. As an intriguing feature, interested buyers also have the option to purchase apartments within this Jumeirah Village Circle hotel.

The First Collection at Jumeirah Village Circle is also a popular hotel in the community. For those seeking more budget-friendly alternatives, Milano by Giovanni Boutique Suites offers hotel apartments in a 4-star setting. This 19-story building offers fully furnished studios and 1- and 2-bedroom units. Plaza Residences, Penrose Place, and HE Hotels are some popular hotel apartments JVC that you must know about.

Attractions and Landmarks

The Dubai Miracle Garden is a prominent landmark in proximity to the JVC properties. This widely-visited tourist attraction showcases 50 million blooming flowers meticulously arranged in various captivating 2D and 3D exhibits.

Adjacent to the garden, the Dubai Butterfly Garden offers another must-visit recreational facility. Furthermore, Wild Wadi Waterpark and Skydive Dubai are popular leisure destinations close to the community.

Those making JVC location their home can explore The Address Montgomerie and The Els Golf Club. Both establishments offer exceptional golfing experiences and feature a range of retail and dining options for added enjoyment.

Contemplating a residence in Jumeirah Village Circle (JVC)? The locality is undergoing several ongoing projects, resulting in some ambient noise in the surroundings. However, upon completion of these constructions, numerous additional amenities are expected to enhance the area.

It's worth noting that JVC currently lacks direct accessibility via the metro, presenting a challenge for individuals dependent on public transportation. Nonetheless, those relying on public transport can conveniently utilize the J01 bus route.

What types of properties are available in JVC?

JVC offers a variety of properties, including apartments, townhouses, and villas. The community is designed to accommodate different preferences and lifestyles.

What amenities does JVC offer?

JVC provides numerous amenities, such as parks, schools, medical facilities, shopping centers, and dining options. The community aims to offer a well-rounded living experience.

Are there recreational facilities in JVC?

Yes, JVC offers parks, jogging tracks, and sports facilities for residents to enjoy outdoor activities. There are also community events organized to enhance the recreational experience.

Is JVC a pet-friendly community?

Many areas in JVC are pet-friendly, and residents can find parks and green spaces suitable for walking their pets.

How is the construction and development at JVC?

JVC is a developing community with ongoing projects. While this may result in some construction noise, it also signifies continuous improvement and the addition of new amenities.

Is Jumeirah Village Circle a good area?

JVC is undoubtedly one of the best areas to live in Dubai. The family-friendly community offers many affordable options with excellent amenities.

Which JVC district is best?

JVC District 13 and District 15 are popular sub-communities with properties available for rent and sale.

Is JVC a good investment?

Multiple projects to choose from and its prime location are the factors that make the district an excellent investment opportunity, ensuring high returns.

What Are the Transportation Options in Jumeirah Village Circle?

Transportation options in Jumeirah Village Circle (JVC) include buses, taxis, and ride-hailing services like Uber and Careem.

Which Metro is Near for JVC?

The nearest metro station to JVC is the Mall of the Emirates Metro Station.

Are There Shopping Malls in Jumeirah Village Circle?

While JVC does not have major shopping malls within the community, it has several retail outlets and is close to larger malls like Mall of the Emirates and City Centre Me'aisem.

How is the Community Spirit in Jumeirah Village Circle?

The community spirit in JVC is vibrant and family-friendly, with numerous parks, community events, and a mix of residents from diverse backgrounds.

What are the Nearest Beaches to Jumeirah Village Circle?

The nearest beaches to JVC are JBR Beach and Kite Beach, both approximately a 20-minute drive away.

data.content:
Jumeirah Village Circle, or JVC, is a popular, family-friendly and affordable residential development by Nakheel. Nestled amidst nature in the heart of Dubai, JVC is an excellent choice to rent or buy property in Dubai at affordable prices.

The self-sufficient community features spacious villas, apartments, and townhouses. Residents of JVC enjoy a host of facilities, including schools, shopping centers, and recreational areas, fostering a sense of community and convenience.

JVC is designed with a circular layout, creating a sense of unity and connectivity. The neighborhood's strategic location provides easy access to major highways, connecting residents to various parts of Dubai.
